gifts.name: Gift of the Screaming Moon
gifts.summary: An alternate Cahalith Moon Gift from a design article: the Gibbous Moon as a bringer of fear and madness on the hunt.

facets.name: Terrorizing Shriek
facets.summary: A howl when ambushing or joining a fight: Glory is a penalty to the prey's roll to react to an ambush and to every prey's Initiative for the fight, and prey with lower Initiative than hers are Shaken.

facets.name: Voice of Fear
facets.summary: Adds Glory to Intimidation for the scene. Once a scene, intimidating prey can make him Shaken (on an exceptional success), turn Shaken into Fugue or Madness, or set off a Fugue or Madness he already has.

facets.name: Mad-Eyed Hunter
facets.summary: Used on gaining Siskur-Dah: prey near her take Glory as a penalty to breaking points; resisting her Lunacy leaves them Shaken, failing gives Madness or Fugue instead, and spirits and other beings with Composure no higher than her Glory suffer Lunacy too.

facets.name: Nightmare Spiral
facets.summary: Against prey she can perceive: one who failed a breaking point since the last gibbous moon fails another (once a month); Madness can become Amnesia, and a Fugue can be set off so she rides the prey's mind until sunrise.
facets.dicePool: Manipulation + Empathy + Glory vs Composure + Primal Urge

facets.name: Soul Shriek
facets.summary: A banshee howl: werewolves and spirits who are outrolled suffer Essence Overload, and others lose their souls to her (Enervated instead on an exceptional success) until she dies or gives them back.
facets.dicePool: Presence + Intimidation + Glory vs Composure + Primal Urge
